subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should agent-owned cron jobs be deleted by the canonical `agents delete` lifecycle for every agent, with Claws only layering provenance cleanup, or should Claws retain a separate deletion contract?
rationale: This PR creates durable scheduler ownership tied to an agent, and choosing a distinct deletion path determines the permanent public lifecycle and recovery semantics; the reviewer and contributor currently disagree on whether the generic behavior must change in this slice.

options.title: Use canonical agent deletion
options.body: Extend the shared agent-deletion lifecycle to remove agent-owned cron jobs durably, then keep Claw-specific cleanup as a narrow wrapper.

options.title: Approve a separate Claw contract
options.body: Keep ordinary agent deletion unchanged, but explicitly document and accept that only Claw removal cleans Claw-owned scheduler provenance.

recommendation.title: Use canonical agent deletion
recommendation.body: Extend the shared agent-deletion lifecycle to remove agent-owned cron jobs durably, then keep Claw-specific cleanup as a narrow wrapper.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and authored the detailed ownership and deletion-contract review feedback.
